canonical_order: Curriculum → Course Details → Requirements → Hosted By → Testimonial → Frequently Asked Questions → Related Knowledge → Knowledge Graph → Applied Case → Enrollment
changes: Rebuilt all 16 course-detail pages from the supplied v3.3.5 complete site baseline in one pass.
Preserved the existing course-specific content, navigation, footer, Courses page, commerce and ecosystem links.
Kept exactly one Hosted By, Testimonial, Related Knowledge, Knowledge Graph and Applied Case section per course page.
Preserved the explicit Related Knowledge layer and made it visually distinct from Knowledge Graph.
Added a resilient testimonial media component with video-first, image-fallback and branded placeholder fallback behaviour.
Removed broken testimonial image/video elements from the initial DOM so missing media files do not render broken-image UI.
When both testimonial image and video become available, the image is automatically used as the video poster and the video takes priority.
Media files can be added later under assets/images/testimonials and assets/videos/testimonials without editing course HTML.
Added responsive course-detail media and knowledge-layer styling.
